nodes.label: Dynamic Light Scheduling & Algae Protection
nodes.description: 1-5 multi-session light scheduling with anti-overlap and 8-hour maximum cumulative cap.

nodes.label: IoT Smart Aquascape Controller (ESP32)
nodes.description: Automated aquarium control and monitoring system based on ESP32 with Telegram bot, captive portal, and full offline autonomy.

nodes.label: Bubble Filter Flow Control
nodes.description: Calibrated percentage-based servo control of filter bubble aeration from 0% to 100%.

nodes.label: NVS Flash Lifespan Preservation
nodes.description: Eliminates per-minute flash writes by only saving cumulative duration on light power-down.

nodes.label: Offline Autonomy
nodes.description: Internal RTC maintains all schedules and actuators when internet or WiFi connection is lost.

nodes.label: Adaptive Fish Feeding & Overfeeding Protection
nodes.description: Multi-time feeder scheduling with adaptive portion sizes (Sedikit, Sedang, Standar) and servo auto-relax.

nodes.label: Telegram Bot Control
nodes.description: Remote control interface via Telegram interactive reply keyboard.

nodes.label: WiFi Captive Portal
nodes.description: Standalone AP setup portal on ESP32 to configure network credentials without hardcoding.
